text:
Sam (eng-platform): Quick sync — we need a 60m design review for the new "batch routing config" feature that touches API, SDK, and Console UX. Goal: finalize API shape, SDK ergonomics, console screens, and rollout strategy. Proposed slots (PT): Tue 9:00-10:00, Wed 13:00-14:00, Thu 16:00-17:00. Pre-read will be a short RFC + Figma mocks + SDK sample. Who's available?

Priya (PM): I'm available Tue or Wed. I'll own the pre-read. Draft RFC link: https://example.com/rfc/batch-routing (will publish final Monday). Pre-read checklist I plan to include: 1) API contract summary, 2) short SDK usage example, 3) Console flows/permissions, 4) migration & rollout notes, 5) known perf targets.

Ruth (Design): Figma prototypes ready (link in RFC). Prefer Wed so I can iterate quickly after morning feedback. Note: need explicit error-state screens and an empty-state mock for first-time orgs.

Jason (Infra): Can we make it 45m instead of 60? Ops would like a focused agenda: API surface (15m), SDK examples (10m), Console walkthrough (15m), open Q&A (5m). Also adding SLO/throughput expectations would help. Wed 13:00 works for me.

Lina (Eng): Wed 13:00 works. Quick ask — can the pre-read include an example of the compiled request body and a sample response for partial failures? saves time during review.

Sam (eng-platform): Good catch, Lina. Priya — can you add a snippet for partial-fail responses? Also, let's lock to 45m per Jason's ask unless folks push back. If no strong objections by EOD Friday we'll book Wed 13:00-13:45 PT.

Priya (PM): Yep — I'll include a minimal `request/response` example and a one-paragraph migration plan. Will post pre-read by Mon EOD and attach to the calendar invite. Example snippet I'll include:

```
POST /v1/batch-routing
{
  "routes": [{"id":"r1","priority":10},{"id":"r2","priority":5}],
  "options": {"prefer_low_latency": true}
}

200 OK
{
  "results": [{"route_id":"r1","status":"applied"},{"route_id":"r2","status":"partial_failure","reason":"quota"}]
}
```

Sam (eng-platform): Cool — vote using reactions: :one: Tue 9, :two: Wed 13, :three: Thu 16. If you prefer Wed but need 60m, reply here.

Ruth (Design): :two: (Wed) — prefer Wed and 45m ok if we keep mock walkthrough tight.

Jason (Infra): :two: and :thumbsup: to 45m.

Lina (Eng): :two:. +1 on including partial-fail example.

deploy-bot: Calendar hold created (tentative) — Wed 2026-03-25 13:00-13:45 PT. Invite will be finalized once pre-read is attached.

Sam (eng-platform): TL;DR: Wed 13:00-13:45 PT tentatively booked. Priya to post pre-read by Mon EOD, include request/response snippet and migration notes. Please react to pick a slot and ping if you need a longer slot. Thanks everyone :pray:
